selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and confirm class alignment with high confidence.
To check for melting or blurring at the critical boundary between the metal rim and the rubber tire, a common AI failure point.
To ensure the complex geometry of the Y-spokes has consistent depth and does not suffer from structural collapse or impossible overlaps.
To analyze the realism of the chrome reflections and ensure they do not contain nonsensical artifacts or texture anomalies.

focus_areas: Realism of chrome reflections on the hub
Consistency of lighting across the wheel face
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the spokes. AI generators often struggle with perfect radial symmetry in alloy wheels. Check if the 'Y' shapes are consistent across all 5 spokes. Also, verify that the reflection on the chrome hub matches the environment (concrete ground/yellow car body) logically.
